notes.title: Update - 2nd October 2024
notes.content:
[b]Time Trial Changes[/b]
We've been busy making some changes and additions to the first gamemode of Virtual Training Ship - 'Time Trial'. We felt this gamemode needed some more challenge and extra enviromental details to help elevate it and make it more engaging for the player.

[b]Winnie[/b]
You're no longer the sole occupier of the house, as Winnie the dog will now follow you around the ground floor. Can you persist with her begging, or will you find her a treat to buy yourself some peace whilst you hunt down the remaining items? 

[b]Safe Puzzle[/b]
We've also added a safe puzzle to solve, the player must find the code and interact with the safes keypad to unlock it and access their passport. 

Alongside this we've added some more models and sound effects to the house to help make it feel more lived in. We hope you enjoy this update and as always welcome your feedback.

Best regards,
[b]- Onboard Maritime Team[/b]

tags.feature: You're no longer the sole occupier of the house, as Winnie the dog will now follow you around the ground floor. Can you persist with her begging, or will you find her a treat to buy yourself some peace whilst you hunt down the remaining items?
We've also added a safe puzzle to solve, the player must find the code and interact with the safes keypad to unlock it and access their passport.
Alongside this we've added some more models and sound effects to the house to help make it feel more lived in.
